name: @stackra/ai
description: Stackra AI kinds for a module's ai/ group: the Prompt, Skill and Facts<M> kind bases, the ToolSource and Approval vocabulary of the generated MCP tool table with approvalFor, retrieve(), the retrieval helper for Facts over the @stackra/search ports, and decide(), a typed choice, score or yes/no answer from a model on AI SDK core; plus the approval-mode resolver (resolveApproval, ApprovalMode) with the AI action permission matrix (ActionPermission, record scope, pack floor), the model router by task, region and data class (routeModel, resolveModel), the context field allow-list and redaction, token budgets, layered guardrails, eval runs and the intent router; the agent runtime (Agent, Promptable, AgentRuntime: prompt, stream, queue, resume) over the ConversationStore and RunStore ports, and in ./node the ADR 0100 tables (conversations, messages, runs, steps, tool calls, approvals, embeddings, A2A tasks) with the Postgres stores and the tenant-key encryption cast; and the PageReader port (readable text and schema.org product hints from one URL) with a memory driver and an egress-bounded HTTP driver
author: Figentra (https://figentra.com)

stackra.summary: Use when a module exposes AI behaviour (prompts, skills, facts for retrieval, typed model decisions through decide()) or must decide which of its actions an AI agent may run as MCP tools and with what approval.
